summary: Verified new SIMPAN HASIL and BAGIKAN actions on the Cetak Biru result screen. Backend sanity confirmed (human_design.py md5=2301ce5b7132cac77bb78d8654dcb97b unchanged, tests/test_human_design.py passes 'All regression tests passed.', pytest 21/21 pass, POST /api/blueprint for Bryan returns Generator/Emotional/5/1). Frontend end-to-end (390x844) fully validated: form fills, city picker returns Jakarta id=1642911, HITUNG CETAK BIRU navigates to result screen with correct values. save-result-button (SIMPAN HASIL) and share-result-button (BAGIKAN) render below the blue callout containing the exact copy 'Ini adalah pola unikmu. Gunakan sebagai peta untuk lebih mengenali cara alami dirimu menjalani kehidupan.'. Preserved layout (Buat ulang back, CETAK BIRU / BLUEPRINT eyebrow, CETAK BIRU KAMU heading, 4 cards TYPE/AUTHORITY/PROFILE/STRATEGY) intact and no raw JSON exposed. Hidden share-card exists in DOM off-screen (x=-10000). Clicking both buttons on web does NOT crash the app - result screen stays intact after 3s.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:229 (pointerEvents="none" prop). Non-blocking - functionality works. Consider moving to style.pointerEvents for future-proofing.

action_items: Optional: migrate `pointerEvents="none"` prop on the cardStage View to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx uses correct testIDs on all new interactive elements (save-result-button, share-result-button, share-card).
Share/Save handlers wrapped in try/catch with graceful toast fallbacks (t.shareUnavailable, t.permDenied, t.err) - safe for web where MediaLibrary/Sharing are not fully available.
Off-screen share card uses left:-10000 correctly and remains in DOM for view-shot capture.
Callout copy matches spec exactly in both id and en text bundles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) in /app/frontend/.env. Backend /api/blueprint requires birth_date in DD-MM-YYYY and city_id as string. Result screen shows action buttons under callout; hidden share-card lives off-screen at x=-10000.
